purpose: Precommit the human perceptual closeout for the already-selected DeepFilterNet treatment after it passes through the integrated 3.6h authorization, 3.6i renderer and 3.6j independent verifier path. This phase validates the integrated treatment path on frozen public evaluation media; it does not authorize or process Guille media and does not change the product default.

case_selection.coverage: exact same 10 cases previously frozen before 3.6e listening: every speaker x noise cell, balanced SNR extremes

integrated_fixture_contract.clean_reference_wav: exact paired VoiceBank+DEMAND clean case; speech-integrity reference only and never selectable

source_media_wrapper.purpose: exercise the real media renderer/verifier path while keeping the source public and frozen
source_media_wrapper.duration_policy: source wrapper ends with its noisy audio; fixture construction may use -shortest, but the denoise renderer itself remains forbidden from using -shortest

authorization.reason: Public frozen evaluation-media closeout only; not Guille media and not product-default authorization.

listening_media_contract.treatment: audio decoded from the fully integrated 3.6i denoise-rendered MP4 after 3.6j technical PASS
listening_media_contract.preserve: audio decoded from the exact source-wrapper MP4 that entered the 3.6i renderer
listening_media_contract.clean_reference: paired clean VoiceBank+DEMAND WAV; reference only
listening_media_contract.reason_for_source_decoded_preserve: Both selectable clips are decoded from the same integrated MP4 container path so preference cannot be driven by source-format asymmetry.

blinding_contract.blinding_algorithm: rank required case ids by ascending sha256(seed + '|' + case_id); integrated treatment is A for first five and B for remaining five

instructions: Use clean_reference.wav only to understand intended speech and detect damaged or missing speech; never choose it as the A/B preference.
Listen to both A and B before any treatment mapping is revealed.
Preference means which selectable version you would choose for the finished video, considering noise, speech naturalness and intelligibility together.
Speech integrity FAIL means a phoneme, word, consonant attack, ending, or intelligible speech content appears removed, clipped, or materially damaged relative to clean_reference.wav.
Artifact FAIL means unacceptable metallic, musical-noise, warbling, pumping, gating, transient, or other processing artifact is audible.
Background noise remaining is not itself an artifact FAIL; it is reflected in preference.
NO_PREFERENCE is valid when neither A nor B is meaningfully preferable.

human_closeout_gate.threshold_source: exact reuse of the already-precommitted Phase 3.6e DeepFilterNet advancement gate; no new numeric preference threshold invented for 3.6k
human_closeout_gate.pass_meaning: The integrated mono DeepFilterNet treatment path is perceptually closed on this frozen public corpus under explicit per-media gating. It does not authorize any particular Guille media, change preserve default, enable auto_apply, or generalize stereo/multichannel.
human_closeout_gate.fail_meaning: Phase 3.6k remains open and preserve remains default; thresholds must not be relaxed post hoc.
